entities.name: SMARCE1
observations: SMARCE1/BAF57 knockdown reduced breast-cancer-cell lung metastasis in xenografts; under detachment it potentiated HIF1A activity and enabled rapid PTK2 activation.

entities.name: HIF1A
observations: HIF1A interacted with SMARCE1 and mediated PTK2 activation during loss of attachment in breast cancer cells.

entities.name: PTK2
observations: PTK2 was indispensable for SMARCE1-mediated protection against anoikis and was positively correlated with SMARCE1 in basal-like and luminal B tumors.

entities.name: PMID:27495308
observations: Study title: SMARCE1 regulates metastatic potential of breast cancer cells through the HIF1A/PTK2 pathway.

entities.name: SMARCE1 metastasis pathway
observations: In breast cancer models, SMARCE1 promoted anoikis resistance through HIF1A-dependent PTK2 activation; SMARCE1 knockdown reduced lung metastasis in vivo (PMID 27495308).
